entity.index is defined as a series tracking a basket of assets. A Sharpe or Treynor ratio is a scalar, not a series. The four named indicators that are their own concepts now take their occurrences by longest match; these remain as guards for the ones that are ratios.

operations.definition: The amount paid above a reference value, such as a bond trading above par.
operations.why: The definition read `the amount paid above a reference, OR the price of an option`. Same elasticity as entity.distribution: under a disjunction covering two unrelated senses no occurrence can be a false positive, so the measurement could never see the conflation. The option sense is now technical.option_premium.
